subject: Hosted inference regional fallback advisory (US-West) — Hightower Capital
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rhodes <emma@hightowercap.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:14:22 -0700
Subject: Hosted inference regional fallback advisory (US-West) — Hightower Capital

Emma —

Quick heads up from our ops team: we observed an elevated rate of container restarts in the US-West serving pool starting at ~08:05 PT this morning. To avoid dropped requests we enacted an automated regional fallback policy that routes a small portion of traffic to our secondary pools and compatible model variants.

Impact summary for Hightower Capital:
- Scope: ~3% of inference requests were routed off to the fallback path between 08:05–08:40 PT.
- Symptom: average p95 increased by ~160ms for affected requests; a tiny subset were served by a quantized variant (no change to prompt content).
- Data: no user prompts or responses were dropped or lost. All requests were still served and logged.

What we’re doing:
- The fallback reduced customer-visible errors while we investigate instance restarts.
- Our teams are tracing the root cause (suspected driver-level memory pressure) and we have a mitigation plan to roll a safe kernel patch and restart the affected pool on a maintenance cadence.
- Estimated restoration ETA: 30–60 minutes for full return to normal routing; we’ll update sooner if that changes.

Resources and immediate asks:
- Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20270509-117-fallback (live incident timeline).
- Attached: incident_onepager.pdf (one-page customer-friendly summary).

If you prefer a short bridge to talk through impact (metrics, credit options) I can open one now — otherwise I’ll follow up here with a restoration update and a postmortem link when available.

Apologies for the interruption — we’re prioritizing this.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Thanks for the quick update, Logan. Two quick questions for our on-call:

If you can open a short bridge that would be helpful — please include ops@hightowercap.com.

emma@hightowercap.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 08:45:38 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted inference regional fallback advisory (US-West) — Hightower Capital

Logan / Hannah —

Bridge is up (ops bridge ID: RB-INC-20270509). Quick notes from infra:
- Root cause: intermittent memory leak in the kernel driver exacerbated by a recent autoscaling profile; triggered restarts under high open-KV cache pressure.
- Short-term fix: we’ve pinned the affected nodes off autoscale and will cycle them with a patched kernel image. Full roll by 09:20 PT.
- Customer impact estimate: peak ~3% of requests routed; p95 for those requests ~+160ms, we expect p95 to return within SLA for the vast majority after the roll.

Attachments: service-metrics-08-13.png (90s window showing spikes).

I’m going to push a targeted rollout to affected racks now. Recommend offering Hightower a 10% credit for the impacted hour and the postmortem once ready.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Site Reliability Engineering
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rhodes <emma@hightowercap.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, ops@hightowercap.com
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted inference regional fallback advisory (US-West) — Hightower Capital

Emma —

Thanks for the questions and for joining the bridge. Short answers up front:
1) ETA & p95: our rollout completed at ~09:02 PT and we see p95 for full routing returning to baseline within the next 5–10 minutes. Any verified regressions will be captured in the incident timeline.
2) Outputs: no requests were re-run; the fallback path used compatible variants and returned single deterministic outputs. I recognize your dedupe window — we did not re-emit requests or duplicate responses.

What we’ve done for you:
- Restored routing to primary US-West pool at 09:02 PT.
- Issued an interim credit offer: 10% of the invoiced tokens for the impacted hour (happy to formalize via your billing contact).
- Postmortem: draft being prepared, will publish to the ops page and send the link here when ready (draft attached: postmortem-draft.pdf).

Links: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20270509-117-fallback (live timeline)
Postmortem draft: https://redwoodai.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/INC-20270509

If you want a short 15-minute technical readout we can schedule it this afternoon — otherwise I’ll follow up with the finalized postmortem and credit paperwork.

Apologies again for the disruption — we’ll share the full RCA and long-term mitigation plan (kernel scheduling change + improved eviction heuristics) in the postmortem.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
